bioconda.name: alignview
bioconda.summary: Sequence alignment inspection and local similarity evidence
bioconda.description:
AlignView is a terminal workspace for nucleotide and protein sequences,
local search evidence, multiple alignments and standalone offline reports.
Viewing existing alignments, the bundled demonstration and report exports
require only Python. Scientific engines are installed separately for the
selected analysis, for example BLAST, DIAMOND, MAFFT or VSEARCH.

commands: alignview report "bioconda smoke project" --html-out "bioconda resumed report.html" --no-open

python -c "import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('bioconda smoke project'); d=json.loads((p/'session.json').read_text()); assert d['msa']; assert (p/'project_manifest.json').is_file(); assert pathlib.Path('bioconda smoke report.html').stat().st_size > 1000; assert pathlib.Path('bioconda resumed report.html').stat().st_size > 1000"
